summary: Host Digital Inc. filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, disclosing that its board approved a stock buyback program on October 19, 2026, authorizing repurchases of up to $15 million of the company's Class A common stock (par $0.001), which trades on NYSE American under HOST. The program commenced October 19, 2026 and expires October 19, 2027, modifiable or suspendable at any time. Repurchases may occur via open-market, privately negotiated, block trades, or Rule 10b5-1 plans, though no purchases or 10b5-1 plan are expected until an open trading window; watch liquidity, financing restrictions, and execution pace as token capital-return signal.
